patches.title: Categorical Target Grab
patches.principle: If the seen object belongs to the same category as the target (e.g., any knife for 'knife'), take it immediately.
patches.when_to_apply: When an object is visible and its type matches the target category.

patches.title: Switch After Non-Target Find
patches.principle: After opening a container that contains a non-target object, switch to a different container type immediately.
patches.when_to_apply: When you open a container and see an object that is not the target.

patches.title: Clean Then Place Directly
patches.principle: After cleaning the object, go directly to the destination without any intermediate actions.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have just cleaned the target object and need to place it.
